summary: Iteration 10: Full end-to-end verification of the /ai-factory STRUCTURAL REDESIGN (industries primary, modes internal per floor). Backend pytest 7/7 passed. Frontend: /ai-factory has ZERO canvases in every state tested (bays view, all 4 floors, all 3 modes, all opened briefs, mobile 390, deep links). Zero console errors across every navigated state. Hero renders 'AI Factory' + italic 'Industry-ready intelligence, built to deploy.' + 'A system for turning business workflows into deployable AI solutions.' + hero SystemLine with 3 nodes and caption 'information → intelligence → action'. Four industry bays render with numbers 01–04; hover reveals ENTER INDUSTRY → indicator (opacity ≈1); click opens the floor (URL updates to ?industry=), the committed bay shows '● FLOOR OPEN'; clicking the committed bay again collapses the floor back to bays view. Keyboard focus + Enter also opens the floor. All four floors verified: correct floor-title (Healthcare/FinTech/Education/Hospitality), correct per-industry narrative sublabels on the SystemLine, floor-modes segmented nav has exactly 3 tabs (case-studies/ready-to-deploy/use-cases). CASE STUDIES: healthcare shows 3 documented cases (Document OCR, Referral Extraction, CognifAI), fintech 2 (Mortgage AI Agent, Invoice Automation), hospitality 1 (Dasa), education renders floor-case-empty 'CASE STUDY IN PROGRESS' with solution-rack and contact links; case row anchors correctly link to /case-studies/<slug>. READY-TO-DEPLOY: exactly 3 solutions per industry, rack-preview-{id} appears on desktop hover, EXPLORE unfolds the full brief (brief-problem/intelligence/workflow/deployment-{id} + nested mini-model-{understand,decide,deploy}); notes verified: claimkavach 'does not submit claims', vaidya-ai 'does not diagnose', rbi-regtech 'Point-in-time replay' + 'The rule decides. The model drafts and explains.'. USE CASES: 5 rows per industry with the exact spec names (verified for healthcare); framing 'shaped per engagement, never claimed as deployed' present; expanding a row shows mini-model + 'Discuss this use case' → /contact. Understand/Decide/Deploy exist ONLY nested inside briefs and use-case details — 0 page-level nav tabs. URL state: no params → bays only (no floor). ?industry=hospitality → hospitality floor + case-studies default. ?industry=fintech&mode=use-cases → resolves. ?solution=policy-copilot → FinTech floor + ready-to-deploy + brief open. ?industry=bogus → bays view (no floor, no crash). ?industry=healthcare&mode=bogus → floor opens on case-studies (aria-selected verified). Legacy ?industry=fintech opens FinTech floor. Switching industries via bays while a brief is open dismisses the brief and returns to case-studies mode. Exactly 1 closing-cta on /ai-factory with correct copy ('Ready to build' / "what's next?" / 'Take an industry workflow from opportunity to production' / 'BUILD WITH CALYZA →' / 'CONTACT US', both → /contact) followed by site-footer; old copy 'Ready to build one of these systems' absent. Mobile 390: docWidth=winWidth=390 (no horizontal overflow), 0 canvas. Homepage regression: exactly 1 canvas + 1 closing-cta on /.
critical_code_review_comments: OPTIONAL: SolutionBrief section testids embed the solution id (brief-problem-{id} etc.). Verified working; adding plain alias testids would be a nicety, not a bug.

OPTIONAL: FloorCaseStudies renders both the container ('floor-case-studies') and the archive link ('floor-case-archive') alongside the per-case rows — any prefix-match selector 'floor-case-*' will therefore over-count. This is intentional given the spec but worth noting for future test authors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The structural redesign is fully in place and functional. Canonical testids: industry-bays, industry-bay-{healthcare|fintech|education|hospitality}, bay-enter-{id}, industry-floor, floor-title, floor-modes, floor-mode-{case-studies|ready-to-deploy|use-cases}, floor-content, system-line, system-node-{input|intelligence|outcome}, system-line-caption, floor-case-studies (container), floor-case-{slug} (rows), floor-case-archive (link), floor-case-empty (education), floor-case-empty-solutions, floor-case-empty-contact, floor-solutions, explore-solution-{id}, rack-preview-{id} (desktop hover only), solution-brief-{id}, brief-problem-{id}, brief-intelligence-{id}, brief-workflow-{id}, brief-deployment-{id}, mini-model-understand/decide/deploy, floor-use-cases, usecase-row-{i}, usecase-detail-{i}, usecase-cta-{i}, closing-cta, site-footer, factory-cta-build, factory-cta-contact. Old testids (factory-index, mode-tab-*, usecase-tab-*, factory-solution-*) are fully retired. Homepage /still has 1 intentional canvas (crystal). Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (7 tests, all passing).
